drawer.sarvamPreviewTitle: Play a sample of this voice

drawer.humanTransferHint: Let the agent hand the caller to a real person. SIP calls only.
drawer.humanTransferSipNote: Transfers run over your SIP trunk. Agents on a Twilio number, and the in-browser test, cannot transfer.
drawer.destinationsHint: The agent is only ever told these IDs and names — never the phone numbers.
drawer.noDestinations: No destinations yet. Add the first person or department this agent can transfer to.
drawer.defaultDestinationHint: Used when the caller just asks for "a person".
drawer.ringTimeoutHint: How long a destination may ring before the caller is handed back to the agent.
drawer.maxTransfersHint: Stops the agent re-dialling an unreachable human over and over.

drawer.errorDuplicateId: Destination ID "{id}" is used more than once.

drawer.errorNoDestinations: Add at least one enabled destination before turning Human Transfer on.
drawer.errorDefaultDestination: The default destination must be one of the enabled destinations.

engines.deepgramAgentNote: Deepgram Voice Agent responds noticeably faster and doesn't require an OpenRouter key.
engines.geminiNote: One Google model hears, thinks and speaks, so replies come back fast and sound conversational. Covers 97 languages including Malayalam. SIP numbers only, and needs just a Gemini API key.
engines.sarvamNote: Sarvam AI runs speech, reasoning and voice entirely on Sarvam (Saaras + Sarvam-105B + Bulbul) for Indian languages. Needs only a Sarvam API key.
engines.twilioStandardNote: Uses Twilio's built-in voices. Switch to a streaming engine for higher-quality, custom voices.

voiceLanguage.label: Language
voiceLanguage.multiHint: Auto-detect allows multi-language within the same call.

voiceQuality.presetHint: Tunes how this agent sounds with the same voice. "Default" keeps the standard pipeline behaviour.
voiceQuality.presetCustomHint: Set the raw ElevenLabs voice settings yourself
voiceQuality.modelAutoHint: Turbo v2.5 for English, Flash v2.5 for other languages
voiceQuality.modelMultilingual: Multilingual v2 — best prosody, higher latency
voiceQuality.latencyQuality: Quality — best prosody, slower first audio
voiceQuality.stabilityHint: Lower = more expressive, higher = more consistent
voiceQuality.endpointingHint: Silence that ends the caller's turn. Lower = snappier answers, higher = fewer cut-offs.
voiceQuality.silenceWaitHint: Extra wait after an unfinished-sounding sentence before the agent answers.
voiceQuality.interruptLow: Low — agent is hard to interrupt
voiceQuality.dgAgentNote: Turn-taking and barge-in are handled server-side by the Deepgram Voice Agent engine; the ElevenLabs model above still applies.

test.title: Testing {name}
test.description: Talk to your agent live in the browser. No phone call is placed and no minutes are used.
test.headphonesHint: Use headphones so the agent doesn't hear itself.
test.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser's address bar, then try again.
test.micUnavailable: No microphone is available, or another app is using it.
test.insecureContext: Microphone access needs a secure (HTTPS) connection.
test.unsupportedBrowser: This browser can't run the live test. Try the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
test.connectionFailed: Couldn't reach the voice service. Check your connection and try again.
test.timeLimit: The test reached its time limit and ended.
test.disconnected: The connection dropped. Start the test again to continue.
test.notTestable: Standard (Twilio) voices are generated by Twilio during a real call, so they can't be previewed here. Switch this agent to a streaming voice engine to test it.
